interpretation.fitting: The exact optimizer and deterministic schedulers contain no learned parameters. The partition is therefore a robustness diagnostic, not a model-selection protocol.
interpretation.selection: All parseable policy observations from the canonical and reproduced outputs are included after content-based deduplication; no best-case filtering is applied.
interpretation.scope: Ratios measure the declared planning-cost model and do not estimate production hit rate, latency, endurance, or device-level write amplification.
